 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site 
 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 Provided by PR Newswire 2026년 10월 29일 오후 3:13:00 
 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 CPSC Posts New Product Recalls and Product Safety Warnings to its Web Site
 PR Newswire
 WASHINGTON, Oct. 29, 2026
 WASHINGTON , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The CPSC announces today the following product recalls and product safety warnings are posted and can be viewed at  www.cpsc.gov . 
 Bodum USA Recalls 5.9 Million French Press Coffee Makers with Replaceable Glass Carafes Due to Risk of Serious Burn Injury | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 5.9 Million
 Incidents: Bodum USA has identified 70 reports of carafes breaking during use, including 48 reports of burns to consumers
 DREO Recalls DR-HSH015 Space Heaters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 338,800
 Incidents: DREO has received 17 reports of space heaters igniting, three resulting in property damage and one in a burn injury to the hand.
 Harkla Recalls Children's Sensory Swings Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fall Hazard | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 25,541
 Incidents: Harkla has received 29 reports of the swing's ceiling hook separating, including 14 injuries that resulted in two concussions, a broken arm, bumps and bruises.
 Yinklev Recalls Jocoevol 6-Drawer Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 32,791
 NTI and HTP Brand Gas Boilers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire, Carbon Monoxide (CO) Poisoning and Impact Hazards; Manufactured by Ariston, formerly NTI Boilers | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 4,726
 Incidents: The firm has received 34 reported incidents of the condensate dish breaking, including three reports of the front cover detaching from the boiler. In one reported incident the technician servicing the boiler sustained a broken jaw. 
 Whatever Works Recalls Microwave Grills Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 8,709
 Incidents: The firm has received three reports of grills igniting, all resulting in fires. No injuries have been reported.
 HAIARA Power Banks Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold on Amazon.com by Mitrytech | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 11,000
 Incidents: Mitrytech has been made aware of 600 reports of fire and other thermal incidents, including three reports of burn injuries and nine reports of property damage. 
 PILLANI Recalls Nursing Pillows Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation; Violate Mandatory Standards for Nursing Pillows | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 25,762
 Fashion Brand Apparel Recalls QZH.DUAO Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children's Sleepwear | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 300
 Longjili Trading Recalls Pamag Pieeoo Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 50
 SOOWERY Recalls 8-Drawer Fabric Dressers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Clothing Storage Units | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 138
 RootStim Recalls Minoxidil Hair Regrowth Treatment Bottles Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Child Poisoning; Violate Mandatory Standard for Child-Resistant Packaging | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 11,000
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using Yfwsrecinoe Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detectors Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 51,825
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using GuardianSense/ KLTseanife Combination Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detectors Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard | CPSC.gov 
 Incidents: Two reports of the alarms failing to alert in the presence of smoke or fire.
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using CHE-US Magnetic Stick Figures Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Toys | CPSC.gov 
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using ASONPAO Ghost Controls Gate Opener Remote Transmitters Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Battery Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Consumer Products with Coin Batteries | CPSC.gov 
 Units:2,610
 CPSC Warns Consumers to Stop Using Magnetic Sensory Fidget Balls Immediately Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Magnets; Sold by Wnd and Clouds' | CPSC.gov 
 Units: 377
 About CPSC  CPSC is the federal agency charged with protecting the public from unreasonable risks of injury associated with thousands of types of consumer products. Deaths, injuries, and property damage from consumer product-related incidents cost the nation more than $1 trillion annually. Since the agency was established more than 50 years ago, CPSC has worked to ensure the safety of consumer products, contributing to a decline in related injuries.
 Federal law prohibits any person from selling products subject to a Commission-ordered recall or to a voluntary recall undertaken in consultation with CPSC.
 For lifesaving information: - Visit CPSC.gov. - Sign up to receive our e-mail alerts . - Follow us on Facebook , Instagram , X , BlueSky , Threads , LinkedIn  and Truth Social . - Report a dangerous product or a product-related injury on www.SaferProducts.gov . - Call CPSC's Hotline at 800-638-2772 (TTY 800-638-8270). - Contact a media specialist .
